title: 7AA.1 DIMASSOC DXF unrepresented-field loss guard
scope: Cross-check the typed DIMASSOC model against Autodesk's published DXF group list
Mark documented unrepresented osnap fields and unknown body fields unsafe for typed rewrite
Preserve tolerant parsing while refusing a lossy typed writer path before publication

implementation.summary: The DIMASSOC DXF parser now sets m_hasUnrepresentableDetail for documented but unmodeled osnap subentity/marker/xref/parameter/WCS-point/intersection/last-point fields, unknown osnap classes and post-body subclasses, orphan osnap type/geometry tags, repeated AcDbDimAssoc markers, and unknown body tags. Modeled table-entry XDATA remains routed through DRW_TableEntry. The existing typed writer gate rejects guarded records before output publication; raw record capture is unchanged.
implementation.limitations: This adds no storage for omitted fields and does not prove associated-target existence/graph closure, live associative updates, or DWG support. Raw capture and typed writer behavior remain separate routes.

sources.title: Autodesk DIMASSOC (DXF)
sources.finding: Published group list includes subentity type/GS marker, XREF handle, near parameter, WCS osnap point, intersection geometry/subentity/marker/XREF, and last-point-reference flag beyond the fields represented by this typed model.

commands.result: passed; documented omitted fields, unknown future field/class/subclass, orphan fields, modeled XDATA, and writer no-publication behavior covered
